blurb: HeliFlite provides private, dual-piloted, twin-engine helicopter charters for business and leisure travel. They offer flexible, on-demand flights with access to exclusive heliports and premier fixed base operators. Popular destinations include NYC, The Hamptons, local airports, Newport, casinos, New England islands, Miami, Palm Beach, and the Bahamas.
